blockingIssues.description: The launcher shutdown callback can still overwrite richer scrolling snapshots with stale manual-run metadata. It now writes `{ profile: args.name, action: args.action, progress: retry_count }`, but scrolling runtimes persist more specific actions (`scroll_feed` / `scroll_reels`) and elapsed progress, so shutdown can still replace the richer snapshot with coarser launcher state.
